today.title: Today's dose vs the WHO guideline
today.calibrateHint: Enter your current indoor or street monitor PM2.5 (µg/m³):
today.next24Sub: PM2.5 forecast by hour. Best and worst windows marked.
today.grap_indicative_note: Official GRAP stage is declared by CAQM and may be invoked on forecasts before thresholds are crossed.
today.trustFooter: Air data: CAMS ENSEMBLE / CAMS global via Open-Meteo · ~25 km model grid, so your street may differ. Saans is not medical advice; follow your doctor's plan for asthma or heart conditions.

plan.waterfallSub: Shapley attribution adds up exactly to the difference between the two days.
plan.addCalendar: Add today's plan to my calendar (.ics)
plan.commuteSub: Compare dose, CO₂e, cost, and time for your trip.
plan.trustNote: Impact is modelled from forecast air, your home profile, and published ranges. Not a medical prediction.

lab.title: Home Air Lab
lab.subtitle: Simulate your room's PM2.5 over 24 hours with low–high uncertainty bands.
lab.vent_found: Best 20-minute window to air out today:
lab.vent_none: No good outdoor airing window today — outdoor PM2.5 stays higher than indoors.
lab.crSub: A box fan + 4× MERV 13 filters delivers 150–360 CFM (255–610 m³/h) CADR at a fraction of commercial cost.
lab.crSafety: Safety: Use a modern fan with an intact cord, keep clear of curtains, and do not leave unattended while sleeping.
lab.snapSub: Take or upload a photo of your purifier or filter box. Photos are read in memory and never stored.

community.title: Community Kit
community.subtitle: Ready-to-share go/no-go guidance for schools, RWAs, and workplaces.
community.act_no_burn_note: Directly stops intense local PM2.5 spikes.
community.act_dust_note: Cuts coarse and fine resuspended road dust.
community.act_idle_note: Lowers tailpipe plume exposure at drop-off/pick-up.
community.act_cr_note: Immediate indoor PM2.5 drop during school hours.
community.act_trees_note: Valuable long-term shade/ecology, but does NOT clear winter smog.
community.act_tower_note: Very limited reach in open outdoor air compared to source control.

proof.title: Proof, Assumptions & Myths
proof.subtitle: Where every number comes from, honest caveats, and verification results.

cr_box.title: Run a DIY Corsi-Rosenthal box filter in the bedroom
cr_box.why: Biggest single saving during 8–10 hours of sleep at home.

hepa_purifier.title: Run a HEPA room purifier (no ionizer)
hepa_purifier.why: Continuously lowers indoor PM2.5 when windows stay shut.

commute_metro.title: Take the metro instead of open road transit
commute_metro.why: Lower roadside plume exposure and much lower CO₂e.

seal_gaps.title: Seal bedroom door and window gaps
seal_gaps.why: Reduces outdoor smog leaking into sleeping spaces.

close_peak_windows.title: Keep windows shut during morning and evening peaks
close_peak_windows.why: Blocks peak traffic and inversion smoke from entering.

cook_hood_shift.title: Use exhaust hood and avoid peak-hour frying
cook_hood_shift.why: Captures cooking particles before they spread through the home.

stop_incense_coil.title: Pause indoor incense and mosquito coils

n95_commute.title: Wear a well-fitted N95/FFP2 during transit
n95_commute.why: Cuts inhaled particles by ~65–90% when outdoors (ages 2+ only).

shift_outdoor_timing.title: Move outdoor play or exercise to the cleaner afternoon dip
shift_outdoor_timing.why: Avoids heavy breathing during morning smog peaks.

wet_mop.title: Wet-mop floors instead of dry sweeping
wet_mop.why: Prevents settled dust from kicking back into indoor air.

tutorial.step1Body: Switch between family members (child, elder, commuter) on the Today tab. The gauge compares their 24-hour PM2.5 dose to the WHO 1× guideline, and the strip chart highlights the cleanest and worst hours.
tutorial.step2Body: Open the Plan tab to toggle actions on or off (DIY CR Box, metro commute, sealing gaps, kitchen hood) and watch your dose drop in real time. You can also compare commute options and export an .ics calendar.
tutorial.step3Body: Simulate room size and purifiers in Home Lab, scan a purifier label, ask Gemini questions (every number is computed by the engine, never guessed), and generate School or RWA advisories in Community.
tutorial.step4Title: 4. Pick a Demo or Your City
tutorial.step4Body: Start with a pre-built Delhi or Ahmedabad winter simulation below, or search your own city anytime in Setup.
